command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$nodes=@('SH_Core','SH_AR','PE2','PE1','PE3','FW_01','Core_SW_01','Core_SW_02'); foreach(`$n in `$nodes){`$a=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ('http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_02/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd=display%20current-configuration')).output; `$b=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ('http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_04/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd=display%20current-configuration')).output; `$al=`$a -split '\r?\n' | Where-Object {`$_ -notmatch 'Last configuration|^20[0-9]{2}-|snmp-agent local-engineid|password cipher'}; `$bl=`$b -split '\r?\n' | Where-Object {`$_ -notmatch 'Last configuration|^20[0-9]{2}-|snmp-agent local-engineid|password cipher'}; `$d=Compare-Object `$bl `$al; if(`$d){'=== '+`$n+' ==='; `$d | ForEach-Object {`$_.SideIndicator+' '+`$_.InputObject}}}"
